title: A common summand for two surjections of finite free modules over a local ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring, meaning a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal. Let $m,n\geq0$ be integers and let $\alpha,\beta:R^{\oplus n}\to R^{\oplus m}$ be surjective $R$-linear maps, where $R^{\oplus t}$ is the module of $t$-tuples with componentwise operations [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. There exists an $R$-submodule $U\subseteq R^{\oplus n}$ such that the restrictions $\alpha|_U:U\to R^{\oplus m}$ and $\beta|_U:U\to R^{\oplus m}$ are both isomorphisms. In particular $R^{\oplus n}=\ker(\alpha)\oplus U=\ker(\beta)\oplus U$.

source.place: Tag 0FJK (lemma-homotopic-surjections), final paragraph: auxiliary common-summand assertion over a local ring, obtained by lifting a simultaneous complement from the residue field.
